verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's first-party pages describe Analytics AI (part of Intuit Intelligence) as explaining which campaigns and automations drive revenue and giving the plain-language reason why. They also say its recommendations are grounded in the store's real sales and customer behavior, alongside listed Predictive Segmentation and generative AI features. This directly matches in-product AI insights and suggestions drawn from the user's own data. Missing for 10: in-depth help or docs on how the insights and recommendations work (scope, plan availability, data sources beyond e-commerce), and independent or hands-on corroboration that they deliver useful suggestions.
